verdict.rationale: Runpod offers several open-protocol ways to get data out, but no documented all-in-one account export. Network volumes are reachable through an S3-compatible API without launching a Pod, and data transfer has no egress fees. The CLI can transfer files to your machine, SSH gives full shell access, and workloads are standard Docker images pulled from any registry, so they stay portable. Missing for 10: a documented 'export all my data' or account-deletion workflow, export of Pod, endpoint, template and billing metadata in open formats, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
